sloka: कः पुमान् हि कुले जातः स्त्रियं परगृहोषिताम् ।तेजस्वी पुनरादद्यात् सुहृल्लेख्येन चेतसा ।। ६.११८.१९ ।।
transliteration: kaḥ pumān hi kule jātaḥ striyaṁ paragṛhoṣitām ।tejasvī punarādadyāt suhṛllekhyena cetasā ।। 6.118.19 ।।

translations.english: "Which eminent man born in a good race will again consciously accept a wife who lived in another's home?"
